# proxmox_groups (Data Source)

Lists Proxmox VE access groups from `/access/groups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "proxmox_groups" "all" {}
```
